items.purpose: Retain thresholds, diagnostics and eligibility
items.current:
Per 12-HPI source tissue: log2 expression change between the 10th and 90th weighted nodule-fate ranks (OT).

Bar = pooled fit (BD + 10x); ○ = BD-only fit, □ = 10x-protoplast-only fit; ▲/▼: platform-specific estimate exceeds the displayed range; hover to see its value.

Solid: fate-associated, with high-fate expression changed at least 1.5-fold versus matched mock in the direction of the fate association, on every assessable platform.
Faded: fate-associated, but mock-comparison requirement was not met.
Grey: valid fit below the fate-effect or noise-ratio threshold.
Hatched: fitting attempted, outside numeric bound*
–: insufficient cells or detected expression to fit.

Dotted lines: ±log2 1.5.

*The fitting algorithm failed to converge; the coefficient or its calculated count-noise scale is invalid; the equations are too poorly determined to calculate a stable noise scale; or the absolute fate coefficient exceeds 10.
